```{r seuil utilisés}
## nombre de jours en dessous duquel on considère qu'on est en début de lactation
## en moyenne avant première IA
early_dim_cutoff <- 90
## SCC cut-off
## seuil de cellules au-delà duquel on considère
## qu'il y a mammite clinique
scc_high_cutoff <- 200
```

# Chargement des données utiles

```{r}
lac <- read.csv2("generated_datasets/lac.csv")
mast_pred <- read.csv2("generated_datasets/mast_pred.csv")
parit_pred <- read.csv2("generated_datasets/parity_pred.csv")
milk_pred <- read.csv2("generated_datasets/milk_pred.csv")
race_pred <- read.csv2("generated_datasets/race_pred.csv")
```

```{r}
level_order <- c("primi_healthy", "primi_env", "primi_cont",
                 "dpLow_healthy", "dpLow_env", "dpLow_cont",
                 "dpHigh_healthy", "dpHigh_env", "dpHigh_cont")

```

# Probabilité d'un SCC élevé au dernier contrôle avant tarissement

## modélisation 

```{r}
lac <- lac |> 
  mutate(parKat = relevel(as.factor(ifelse(parity > 3, 4, parity)), ref = "3"),
         race = relevel(factor(race), ref="PH"))
```


```{r}
scc_high_dp_model <- glmer(infct_end_lac ~ parKat +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p1 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p2 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p3 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p4 +
                             mast_cat1 +
                             race +
                             (1| herd_id),
                           family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                           data = lac, 
                           subset = n_ctrl_early > 0 & repro == 1 & dp_mis == 0 & !is.na(infct_end_lac),
                           control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

summary(scc_high_dp_model)
```

## Prédictions 

```{r}
mast_pred <- mast_pred |> 
  mutate(race = as.factor(race),
         parKat = as.factor(parKat),
         mast_cat1 = as.factor(mast_cat1))
```


```{r}
prd <- predictions(model = scc_high_dp_model,
                   newdata = mast_pred,
                   re.form = NA, type = "response")

ggplot(prd, aes(x = factor(mast_cat1, level = level_order), y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = mast_cat1, y=conf.low, xend = mast_cat1, yend = conf.high))+
  xlab("Statut mammite")+
  ylab("probabilité d'un SCC élevé au dernier contrôle avant tarissement")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
parit_pred <- parit_pred |> 
  mutate(race = as.factor(race),
         parKat = as.factor(parKat),
         mast_cat1 = as.factor(mast_cat1))
```


```{r}
prd <- predictions(model = scc_high_dp_model,
                   newdata = parit_pred,
                   re.form = NA, type = "response")

ggplot(prd, aes(x = factor(parKat), y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = parKat, y=conf.low, xend = parKat, yend = conf.high))+
  xlab("parité")+
  ylab("probabilité d'un SCC élevé au dernier contrôle avant tarissement")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
race_pred <- race_pred |> 
  mutate(race = as.factor(race),
         parKat = as.factor(parKat),

```

```{r}
ggplot(prd, aes(x = factor(race), y = estimate)) +

  geom_segment(aes(x = race, y=conf.low, xend = race, yend = conf.high))+
```

```{r}
milk_pred <- milk_pred |> 
  mutate(race = as.factor(race),
         parKat = as.factor(parKat),
         mast_cat1 = as.factor(mast_cat1))
```

```{r}
prd <- predictions(model = scc_high_dp_model, 
                   newdata = milk_pred, 
                   re.form = NA, type = "response")

ggplot(prd, aes(x = milk_early_max, y = estimate, col = parKat)) +
  geom_line() 
```

# Probabilité de guérison au tarissement 

## modélisation 

```{r}
cure_dp_model <- glmer(nxt_cure ~ parKat +
                          milk_early_max_scaled_p1 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p2 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p3 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p4 +
                             mast_cat1 +
                             race + 
                             (1| herd_id),
                           family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                           data = lac, 
                           subset = n_ctrl_early > 0 & repro == 1 & dp_mis == 0 & !is.na(nxt_cure),
                           control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

summary(cure_dp_model)
```

## Prédictions

```{r}
prd1 <- predictions(model = cure_dp_model,
                   newdata = mast_pred,
                   re.form = NA, type = "response")

ggplot(prd1, aes(x = factor(mast_cat1, level = level_order), y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = mast_cat1, y=conf.low, xend = mast_cat1, yend = conf.high))+
  xlab("statut mammite")+
  ylab("probabilité d'une guérison pendant le tarissement")+
```


# Probabilité d'une nouvelle infection après tarissement

## modélisation 

```{r}
new_inf_model <- glmer(nxt_ninf ~ parKat +
                          milk_early_max_scaled_p1 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p2 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p3 +
                             milk_early_max_scaled_p4 +
                             mast_cat1 +
                             race +
                             (1| herd_id),
                           family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                           data = lac, 
                           subset = n_ctrl_early > 0 & repro == 1 & dp_mis == 0 & !is.na(nxt_ninf),
                           control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

summary(new_inf_model)
```
